datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Malawi administrative units on a regular monthly schedule (January, April, July, October 2014). The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, georeferenced to administrative boundaries and compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for near-term food security assessments.
